items.title: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens - GitHub Changelog
items.summary: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens You can now use expiring, automatically refreshing OAuth credentials in GitHub CLI as part of a public preview. When you opt in, gh stores an expiring access token alongside a rotating refresh token and automatically refreshes the token...
